gloss: this person and that; anyone and everyone

definitions.gloss: this person and that; anyone and everyone; whoever
definitions.explanation: Refers indiscriminately to various people without specifying who. Often used with なく or かまわず to express doing something without regard to who is involved.

examples.japanese: {誰彼|だれかれ}なく{話|はな}しかける。
examples.english: To talk to anyone and everyone.

examples.japanese: {誰彼|だれかれ}かまわず{愚痴|ぐち}をこぼす{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: There are people who complain to anyone who will listen.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{誰彼|だれかれ}なく{優|やさ}しく{接|せっ}するので、みんなに{好|す}かれている。
examples.english: She treats everyone kindly without exception, so everyone likes her.

notes:
A compound of {誰|だれ} (who) and {彼|かれ} (that person), meaning "this person and that person" — i.e., anyone without distinction. Most commonly appears in the pattern {誰彼|だれかれ}なく (without regard to who).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誰彼|だれかれ}なく: to anyone; indiscriminately
- {誰彼|だれかれ}かまわず: without caring who; regardless of who
- {誰彼|だれかれ}となく: from various people; from no one in particular

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誰|だれ}でも: anyone; everybody — more common in everyday speech
- {誰|だれ}にでも: to anyone — similar meaning but more colloquial
- {不特定多数|ふとくていたすう}: unspecified large number of people — formal, often administrative

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary and formal. More common in written language than casual speech. The pattern {誰彼|だれかれ}なく is the most frequently encountered usage.
